army_crosslink_direct.note: 2db recheck: no CArmy*/req/handle in theatre blob; no CPdxArray of armies; no CCountry* in HAI theatre; no army ptrs via air-mgr; HAI CCountry has no direct army ptr/array in first 0x2000. Army→theatre @CArmy+0x2a0 remains one-way.

army_upgrades_status_ptr.note: shared singleton; +0x38→same HAI CCountry as reinf

peer_carmy_ptr_hyp.note: +0x108/+0x130/+0x190 hold the SAME CArmy* (16/17). Not self. Often same theatre as owner. Not bidirectional; peer→peer continues a chain (not a 2-cycle). Not a complete army vector. Treat as one logical related-army field with two alias copies.

theatre_ptr.note: Per-object field; not a multi-slot base.

controller_area_ptr.note: Per-object field; not a multi-slot base.

object_stride_packed.note: Heap often packs CFront objects contiguously at stride 0x90.

slot_array.note: 2cy-2da 'slot k' reads were the theatre/controller of the packed neighbor CFront at F+k*0x90, not fields of a single object. Do not use multi-slot formula.

field_map_cfront.hai_theatre_fronts_any_slot_note: Prior any-slot counts (30/44/60/92) inflated by walking packed neighbors; correct HAI front count via theatre@+0x18 is 6.

embedded_parent_slot_theatre_ptrs.note: See embedded_theatre_ptrs; multi-slot parent indexing withdrawn.

embedded_theatre_ptrs.note: Stable CTheatre* embeds remain @+0x28/+0x40/+0x58 (+0x70 repeats). With multi-slot REJECTED: these match theatres of packed-run CFront neighbors relative to parent, not slots of one parent object. parent+0x18 match at +0x28 was 0 this session.

country_tag.note: u32@+0x8; HAI tag=15 on 8 sampled sections

inline_carmy_ptrs.note: CArmy* appear at variable offs inside HAI sections (no stable single field / no begin-end vector proven); treat as observe-only.
